# ALGAL

ALGAL is a programming language and application VM for bounded agent programs. Programs ("organisms") are typed, content-addressed data: they wait without dying, remember across runs, propose their own successors, and leave a verifiable fossil of every execution. Model judgment is a declared, budgeted effect; everything around it is pure dataflow. A native Rust kernel and a TypeScript/Bun reference runtime execute the same manifest, and a saved run can hand off between them.

## Pages

- [The language for living programs](https://algal.computer/): vision, organism anatomy, the habitat machine, fossils, reproduction and selection
- [Inside a living program — tour](https://algal.computer/tour/): executable walkthrough with recorded runs, replayable interactive diagrams, diagnostics, and composition examples
- [Put living programs to work](https://algal.computer/use-cases/): durable review, checked coding repair, portable execution evidence, reusable routing, and the adoption boundary

## Honesty notes

- Site demos use scripted executor answers; every published run is a real replay-verified receipt.
- Receipts prove execution consistency, not model truth or provider attestation.
- Organisms can propose successor manifests as data; admission, measurement, and selection stay host-owned.
